actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The card's entry symbol LM4ManipDMEnv is a dm_control composer.Environment subclass that overrides reset and step
The card lists the xarm7 scene as models[1]: its root is '<mujoco model="xarm7 scene">' and it includes xarm7.xml
The xarm7 model root is '<mujoco model="xarm7">' and its compiler sets autolimits=true
The robot config maps the xarm robot to xarm7/xarm7.xml and gives it 8 default_qpos values
The model sets no option timestep: its <option> element carries only integrator=implicitfast
The model has 8 actuators: act1 to act7 on the seven arm joints and a gripper actuator on the split tendon
The default class xarm7 states a general ctrlrange of -6.28319 to 6.28319 for the arm actuators
act2 states ctrlrange -2.059 to 2.0944, act4 -0.19198 to 3.927, act6 -1.69297 to 3.14159 and the gripper 0 to 255
The model has 13 hinge joints: joint1 to joint7, the left and right driver, finger and inner-knuckle joints
The gripper tendon couples the left and right driver joints with coef 0.5
The scene adds a floor plane and a cylindrical pad to the xarm7 model
The env factory loads the robot from robot_config and constructs LM4ManipDMEnv(task, time_limit, reset_wait_step)

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state, but the bridge takes no seed input and a reset restores the model defaults, so no seed selects a different initial state; the fake's placeholder integration was not compared with the engine

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the MJCF text for the actuator control ranges, the joint count and the time step, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target; no contact, tendon, equality or actuator dynamics and no mesh or texture is loaded
the model sets no option timestep (xarm7.xml:4); the stand-in uses 0.002 s as a placeholder for the library default, so the reference's timestep_ms is a stand-in value, not a measurement
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine

the package serves the xarm7 MuJoCo model, not the dm_control environment LM4ManipDMEnv or a task scene: rendering, the environment's rgb/depth/segmentation/point-cloud observations, the reset wait steps and the random layout of the environment are not modelled
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
no physical robot is modelled and nothing was validated against the xArm hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the model integration state is kept and stays readable
